prompt: Use case: sketch-to-render. Create the FINAL playable pixel-art HOUSE INTERIOR from Image 1, an architectural layout guide. Image 2 is STYLE ONLY, do NOT copy its layout. Output exact 1536x1024. Image 1 is authoritative for house silhouette, all room positions and sizes, wall segments, open door gaps, bottom entrance, and every labeled furniture bounding box. Paint every block into its named furniture at exactly the same position/footprint; blue BED blocks are single beds unless identified double below. Green CHAIR is sofa/chair with readable seating. Orange KITCHEN is stove/sink counter. Brown DESK/TABLE/SHELF/ALBUM/CABINET become matching objects. Keep walkways and doorway gaps completely empty. DO NOT add large extra floor furniture, rooms, walls, doors, beds or people. Dark background outside cutaway footprint must remain dark and empty; do not enlarge a compact home to fill the canvas. Flat overhead three-quarter Stardew Valley inspired crisp 16-bit game pixel art, hard pixel clusters, limited shading, dark pixel edges, Nordic timber/plaster/stone interiors. No blur, painterly strokes, photorealism, perspective convergence or isometric diamond. Small decorations may be ON furniture or walls; flat rugs underfoot do not block paths. REMOVE ALL guide labels and flat color blocks, no writing, UI, watermark. Room walls must not hide doorway gaps. Do not introduce closed doors. Household artistic identity (use as aesthetic direction ONLY; the guide overrides all described left/right/upper locations): Mike and Clara married couple living ABOVE A SEED SHOP: seed-merchant HOME. Light yellow plaster, chestnut wood, spring green and warm cream textiles. Existing kitchen counter has grain jars, scale and small seed packets without writing, walls have dried seed heads. Shared double quilt soft green tiny leaf motif. Upper middle workdesk has botanical notebook and neatly sorted seed boxes. Lower right shelves filled with small jars and household books, harvest-yellow armchair, flat woven oat pattern rug, domestic cozy upstairs apartment not shop showroom.. The only BED is a shared DOUBLE bed.  STRICT BED COUNT: ONE double bed. Never put any bed in a study or gallery.
